MATD.description: Modify SRC Design Material - AIK-SRC2K (MATD). Modify-only payload patching an existing Type="SRC" material record; each Assign value carries STEEL, CONCRETE, and REINFORCEMENT sub-objects whose fields are driven by each sub-object's CODE (None | Standard).

STEEL.description: STEEL section (written to Data1). CODE drives branching: Standard auto-fills ES/FU/Fy from the grade lookup; None takes NAME + ES/FU/FY from the request body.

CODE.description: Steel code kind (None | Standard). Case-insensitive enum.

STANDARD_CODE.description: Standard steel code (must be 'KS22(S)' when CODE=Standard).

GRADE.description: [CODE=Standard] Steel grade name (e.g. SS275) -- required when CODE=Standard.

NAME.description: [CODE=None] User steel name -- required when CODE=None.

FY.description: [CODE=None] Yield strength Fy (>0) -- canonical when CODE=None (fanned out to S_Fy1..S_Fy10).

FY1.description: Yield strength Fy1 (>0) -- ignored under CODE=None; auto-filled from grade lookup under CODE=Standard.

FY2.description: Yield strength Fy2 -- ignored (fanned out from S_Fy1 for AIK-SRC2K).

FY3.description: Yield strength Fy3 -- ignored (fanned out from S_Fy1 for AIK-SRC2K).

FY4.description: Yield strength Fy4 -- ignored (fanned out from S_Fy1 for AIK-SRC2K).

FY5.description: Yield strength Fy5 -- ignored (fanned out from S_Fy1 for AIK-SRC2K).

CONCRETE.description: CONCRETE section (written to Data2). Standard auto-fills FC + Analysis.* from the grade lookup; None takes NAME + FC from the request body.

CODE.description: Concrete code kind (None | Standard). Case-insensitive enum.

STANDARD_CODE.description: Standard concrete code (must be 'KS19(RC)' when CODE=Standard).

GRADE.description: [CODE=Standard] Concrete grade name (e.g. C30) -- required when CODE=Standard.

NAME.description: [CODE=None] User concrete name -- required when CODE=None.

REINFORCEMENT.description: REINFORCEMENT section (written to Rebar_CodeName/MainRebarData/SubRebarData). Standard auto-fills B_fy/B_Elast/B_Density from the grade lookup; None takes names + FYR/FYS from the request body.

CODE.description: Reinforcement code kind (None | Standard). Case-insensitive enum.

STANDARD_CODE.description: Standard rebar code (must be 'KS19(RC)' when CODE=Standard).

MAIN_REBAR_GRADE.description: [CODE=Standard] Main rebar grade (e.g. SD400) -- required when CODE=Standard.

MAIN_REBAR_NAME.description: [CODE=None] Main rebar user name -- required when CODE=None.

SUB_REBAR_GRADE.description: [CODE=Standard] Sub rebar grade (e.g. SD400) -- required when CODE=Standard.

SUB_REBAR_NAME.description: [CODE=None] Sub rebar user name -- required when CODE=None.
